title: Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates Acts 4: after a lame man is healed, Peter and John are arrested, Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, says the man was healed by the name of Jesus and salvation is in no other name, and they refuse to stop speaking about Jesus.

floor.question: What did Stephen pray as he was stoned?
floor.answer: Lord, do not hold this sin against them

representations: a picture of Peter and John before the council
steps: Peter speaks boldly: by the name of Jesus.
They will not stop speaking about Jesus.
contexts: a child teased for saying grace
a learner asked to lie to cover a friend

board.do: Draw a council and two men standing.

board.say: By whose power did he say the man was healed?

board.do: Wait for the child to say the name of Jesus.

listen_for: He was afraid and said he did not know Jesus
misconceptions.ask: How did Peter speak to the rulers in Acts 4?
misconceptions.repair: Read Acts 4:8 and 4:13: "filled with the Holy Spirit", "the courage of Peter and John".

listen_for: That there are many ways and names
misconceptions.ask: What did Peter say about salvation in Acts 4:12?

listen_for: By the power of Peter and John
misconceptions.ask: By whose power did Peter say the man had been healed?
What did Peter and John answer when told not to speak about Jesus (Acts 4:19-20)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Acts 4:19-20 aloud: they asked whether to obey God or people.

checks.question: By whose name was the man healed?
Did Peter and John agree to stop speaking about Jesus?
